title: Use a weak-force endpoint bound with common bounded feedback
statement: The reviewed quantitative-control construction converts supplied weak-force norm eta and initial TV E0 into uniform finite-horizon controlled path/endpoint estimates for common bounded Borel feedback. Its safe transition estimate is C_tr eta h^(-5/8); the review supplies a stronger endpoint extraction C eta h^(1/16). Fixed bath/regularity constants and the source entropy-to-input bridge remain explicit.

requires: Native underdamped torus dq=p dt, dp=[F(q)-gamma p+u]dt+sqrt(2gamma tau)dW with fixed physical reversal/entropy interpretation
Acquired baseline position W1 fit, actual physical entropy upper bound and declared amplitude/temperature ceilings
Bounded common Markov force port; for adaptive snapshots, current-state observation kernels, measurable report-driven scheduling and an actual joint physical-state/history preparation bound

assumptions: Fixed torus/dimension, directly thermalized momenta, known gamma/tau and bounded force amplitudes are real input information. No force-derivative bound is assumed. Retained burn-in transcripts/correlated preparation need actual joint error; changing increasingly resolved path scores compressed into one bit defeat broader replacement. No exclusive computational or practical advantage.
